info.name: Quix Cloud HTTP APIs Definitions Parameter Data API

params.name: topicName
params.description: The name of the topic the stream belongs to.

params.name: streamId
params.description: The unique identifier of the stream. Publishing to an id that does not exist creates the stream implicitly.

items.docs: Publishes one or more time-series parameter samples to a stream. The payload carries an array of nanosecond `timestamps` plus values keyed by parameter name under `numericValues`, `stringValues`, and/or `binaryValues`. Publishing to a non-existent `streamId` implicitly creates the stream.
